subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to London on August 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number: AB123, Departure time: 9:00 AM, Seat: 23A. Please ensure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you onboard! Safe travels.
